lines:
sequenceDiagram
actor UI as UI Projection Gateway
participant API as Desktop Command/Event API
participant Life as Chat/Run Lifecycle
participant Freeze as Snapshot Freezer
participant Config as Project & Config Coordinator
participant Ext as Extension Registry
participant Auth as Authority Engine
participant Commit as Canonical Committer
participant Sup as Process Supervisor
participant Worker as Workflow Worker
UI->>API: StartChatV1(commandId, draftId, expectedVersion, firstInput)
API->>Life: handle StartChatV1
Life->>Freeze: FreezeForFirstInputV1(draft, workflowRef, projectScope)
Freeze->>Config: load exact JSON documents and resolve workspace
Config-->>Freeze: DocumentSetV1 versions hashes and WorkspaceBindingV1
Freeze->>Ext: pin required contribution identities versions hashes
Ext-->>Freeze: ExtensionPinSetV1 or missing incompatible disabled facts
Freeze->>Auth: compile manifest and concise authority summary
Auth-->>Freeze: AuthorityManifestV1 and AuthoritySummaryV1
Freeze->>Config: revalidate document workspace and binding versions
Config-->>Freeze: VersionFenceV1
alt validation resolution compatibility or version fence fails
  Freeze-->>Life: ValidationReportV1 blocked with stable diagnostics
  Life->>Commit: commit StartRejectedV1 against unchanged draft version
  Commit-->>API: committed rejection event
  API-->>UI: rejection projection. Draft and complete graph remain editable
else all required inputs are ready
  Freeze-->>Life: FrozenRunSnapshotV1 with content hash
  Life->>Commit: atomic ChatStarted + WorkflowFrozen + InputAccepted + AuthorityBound + StartWorker outbox
  Commit-->>Life: durable head and outboxId
  Commit-->>API: ordered committed event envelopes
  API-->>UI: locked workflow and starting Run projection
  Life->>Sup: spawn expected worker generation for committed outbox
  Sup->>Worker: StartRunV1(snapshot, initial checkpoint, generation)
  Worker-->>Sup: ReadyV1(snapshotHash, generation)
  alt handshake matches
    Sup-->>Life: ProcessReadyV1
    Life->>Commit: mark outbox delivered and commit RunReadyV1
  else spawn or handshake fails
    Sup-->>Life: ProcessStartFailedV1
    Life->>Commit: commit RunDegradedV1. Retain pending recoverable control intent
  end
end
Note over Life,Commit: No worker sees first input before the immutable snapshot and lifecycle state are durable

data.title: First Input Validation, Resolution, Freeze, and Start
